verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports bulk-style automation via Collection Runner (multiple requests in order, unlimited runs), Inso CLI for CI automation, and chaining/scripting across requests, which covers batch execution of many items. However, evidence does not show AI-native/agentic bulk operations (e.g., bulk edit, bulk delete, or programmatic manipulation of many items via an AI agent or API) beyond request execution — missing for 10: evidence of bulk editing/deleting/modifying multiple collection items programmatically, and any AI-agent-specific bulk operation tooling beyond running/testing requests.
